evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters block-connection and chainstate activation logic in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Prefetching and deserializing blocks in the background yields substantial, durable performance gains for IBD and chain reindexing. Benchmark results show a 1.53x–1.57x speedup for reindex-chainstate and a 1.13x speedup for full IBD, which was corroborated independently by reviewers.
